notes.title: Release of Strawb
notes.notes:
Ahoi,
I am happy to announce that the puzzle game Strawb is released.
In Strawb you have to find your way through challenging puzzles and catch your friend by clever movement and destruction of blocks. 

As a solo hobby developer things take more time and so the development of Strawb took around 1.5 years.

Here is a screenshot from one of the first prototype version. Things have changed ;)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579232/8c04c5c604689e2f39a1cad93d7850327a8f8c01.jpg

I hope you enjoy Strawb.
I am always happy to receive feedback froum you.

Take care,
Noxlor
